北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -8℃，注意保暖防寒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is clear and cold, feels like -8℃. Stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雨体感 2℃，出行记得带伞，注意防潮。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is rainy, feels like 2℃. Bring an umbrella and stay dry!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴冷体感 2℃，记得添衣，湿气也重哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and cool, feels like 2℃. Add layers, it's humid.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云舒适，体感 23℃，湿度较高，注意通风。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and pleasant, feels like 23℃. High humidity, ventilate!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云暖和，体感 21℃，湿度大，记得多喝水。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and warm, feels like 21℃. High humidity, stay hydrated.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨体感 -1℃，出门加厚衣物，当心着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain, feels like -1℃. Wear warm clothes, avoid colds.
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷体感 -1℃，注意添衣保暖，湿度也高哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and cold, feels like -1℃. Dress warmly, it's humid too.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 6℃ 左右，早晚温差大，注意加衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels around 6℃. Big temp difference, dress accordingly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷体感 -1℃，北风微凉，记得多穿点。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast and cold, feels like -1℃. North wind is cool, dress warmly.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷潮湿，湿度 100%，多喝热水，注意防湿。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, cold, and 100% humid. Drink hot water, stay dry.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 11℃，早晚温差大，记得加衣。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels like 11℃. Big temp difference, dress accordingly.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴冷体感 -19℃，请务必全副武装，防寒保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear and icy, feels like -19℃. Bundle up completely!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 -16℃，风虽小，也要多穿防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like -16℃. Even with light wind, dress warmly.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗体感 5℃，注意早晚温差，舒适出行。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear, feels like 5℃. Mind the day-night temp difference, enjoy your day.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，能见度低，体感 17℃，出行注意安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy, low visibility, feels like 17℃. Travel safe.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷体感 -9℃，北风呼啸，防风保暖是重点！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast and cold, feels like -9℃. North wind howls, stay warm and sheltered!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -12℃，风力不小，多穿衣服别冻着。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -12℃. Windy, dress warmly to avoid freezing.
